structure.unit: Provisions Relating to Insurance Policies and Contracts

law.catch_line: Contingent liability provisions in policies issued by certain mutual insurers
law.text: Except in the case of nonassessable policies, the contingent liability of each member of a mutual insurer, other than a life insurer, shall be clearly stated in the mutual insurer's policies. The contingent liability may be limited, but such limitation shall not be less than one additional annual premium on each policy held by the member.
